caption: The drawing depicts a detailed design for a rectangular mirror frame with classical architectural elements. The main object is a tall, vertical mirror framed in a brown, wood-like material with columns on each side and decorative capitals at the top left and right corners. The top section of the frame contains a rectangular inset with an ornamental landscape painting showing brown ruins, green trees, and a blue-and-pink sky. The lower, larger section is filled with a vertically-mounted mirror rendered in shades of light blue, white, and soft purple. Detailed pencil-drawn diagrams are included on the left and right sides, showing side and section views of the frame, including measurements and the profile of the columns and capital. The artist's name, A. Walbeck, is signed in the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Colonial Mirror
